spans.s: प्रपक्ष m. The extremity of a wing.

प्रपंच m. 1. Amplification, expansion; 2. copiousness, prolixity; 3. quantity, abundance; 4. diversity; 5. elucidation, explanation; 6. phenomenon, appearance; 7. trick, deceit, delusion; 8. the world considered as the expansion of the primary germ and as the scene of manifold action.
प्रपंच-बुद्धि a. cunning, artful.
प्रपंच-वचन a. a prolix discourse.
प्रपंचन n. 1. Diffusion; 2. exposition, explanation.
प्रपंचित a. (f. ता) 1. Amplified, expanded; 2. explained, expatiated upon; 3. mistaken, erring; 4. deceived, imposed upon.
प्रपंचित a. (f. ता) 1. Amplified, expanded; 2. explained, expatiated upon; 3. mistaken, erring; 4. deceived, imposed upon.
प्रपतन n. 1. Flying forth; 2. falling down, alighting; 3. death, destruction; 4. a precipice, a rock.
प्रपातन n. Throwing down.
प्रपद n. The forepart of the foot.
प्रपदीन a. (f. ना) Relating to the forepart of the foot.
प्रपदीन a. (f. ना) Relating to the forepart of the foot.

प्रपन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Adhering to; 2. possessed of, furnished with; 3. promised; 4. poor, distressed; 5. seeking for protection, taking refuge, suppliant, शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् R.ii.7.

प्रपन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Adhering to; 2. possessed of, furnished with; 3. promised; 4. poor, distressed; 5. seeking for protection, taking refuge, suppliant, शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् R.ii.7.
प्रपन्नाड m. The same as प्रपुनाट q.v.
प्रपर्ण n. A fallen leaf.
प्रपलायन n. Flight, retreat.
प्रपा f. 1. A well, a cistern, M.viii.319; 2. a place where water is distributed; 3. a supply of water; 4. a place for watering cattle.
प्रपा-वन n. a cool grove.
प्रपाठक m. A chapter or subdivision of a book.
प्रपाणि m. The back of the extended hand.

प्रपात m. 1. Going away, departure; 2. failing down upon, a fall, K.S.vi.57; 3. a sudden attack; 4. throwing oneself down from a rock; 5. emission, discharge (as in वीर्यप्रपात); 6. a spring, a watercourse; 7. a bank, a shore, R.ii.26; 8. a precipice.
प्रपादिक m. A peacock.
प्रपानक n. A kind of drink or beverage.
प्रपितामह m. 1. A paternal great grandfather, M.iii.284; 2. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa, Bg.xi.39; 3. of Brahman (m.)
प्रपितामही f. A paternal great grand-mother.
प्रपितृव्य m. A paternal grand-uncle.
प्रपीडन n. 1. Pressing, squeezing; 2. an astringent.
प्रपीत(न) a. (f. ता) Swollen, extended.
प्रपीत(न) a. (f. ता) Swollen, extended.
प्रपीत(न) a. (f. ता) Swollen, extended.
प्रपुना(न्ना)ट m. The chakramarda tree.
प्रपुना(न्ना)ट m. The chakramarda tree.
प्रपुना(न्ना)ट m. The chakramarda tree.
प्रपुना(न्ना)ट m. The chakramarda tree.
प्रपूरण n. 1. Filling, filling up; 2. inserting, injecting; 3. satisfying, satiating.
प्रपूरित a. (f. ता) Filled up.
प्रपूरित a. (f. ता) Filled up.
प्रपृष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Having a prominent back.
प्रपृष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Having a prominent back.
प्रपौत्र m. A great grandson, Yaj.i.78.
प्रपौत्री f. A great grand daughter.
प्रापक a. (f. पिका) 1. Providing with, procuring; 2. establishing.
प्रापक a. (f. पिका) 1. Providing with, procuring; 2. establishing.
प्रापण n. 1. Reaching, extending; 2. conveying, leading to; 3. attainment, acquisition, M.ii.95.
प्रापणिक m. A trader, a merchant.
प्राप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Attained to, reached; 2. obtained, acquired, won; 3. endured, suffered; 4. present; 5. completed; 6. proper, right, (pp. of आप् with प्र q.v.).
प्राप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Attained to, reached; 2. obtained, acquired, won; 3. endured, suffered; 4. present; 5. completed; 6. proper, right, (pp. of आप् with प्र q.v.).
प्राप्त-अनुज्ञ a. allowed to depart.
प्राप्त-अर्थ a. successful.
प्राप्त-अवसर a. finding occasion or opportunity.
प्राप्त-उदय a. one who has attained exaltation.
प्राप्त-काल (I) a. 1. opportune, seasonable, e.g. अप्राप्तकालं वचनं बृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन्; 2. marriageable; 3. destined, fated.
प्राप्त-काल (II) m. a suitable opportunity, a fit time.
प्राप्त-पंचत्व a. dissolved into the five elements, i.e. deal, deceased.
प्राप्त-प्रसव a. delivered of a child.
प्राप्त-भार m. a beast of burden.
प्राप्त-मनोरथ a. one who has obtained his wish.
प्राप्त-यौवन a. arrived at puberty, youthful.
प्राप्त-रूप a. 1. beautiful, handsome; 2. wise, learned; 3. fit, proper, suitable.
प्राप्त-व्यवहार m. a young man come of age and legally authorized to conduct his own affairs (in law).

प्राप्ति f. 1. Attaining to, reaching; 2. acquisition, gain, attainment, Yaj.i.78; 3. guess, conjecture; 4. share, portion, lot; 5. a collection, an assemblage; 6. rise, production; 7. the power of obtaining anything considered as one of the eight super-human powers; See under सिद्धि; 8. the successful termination of a plot (in dramaturgy) (प्राप्तिः सुखागमः).
प्राप्ति-आशा f. 1. hope of obtaining; 2. the hope of obtaining considered as a part of the development of a play.
